rationale: Fixed latency limits are unchanged. Noninteractive diagnostic control: warm managed 14.3..17.2 MiB, private maximum 146.7 MiB, max five-cycle growth 0.37 MiB, ready queue <=3/26.1ms, visual wait <=190.7ms, priority probes <=66.9ms. Ceilings allow GC/native variability while requiring zero closed-window roots, zero lost observations, <=1 owned visual operation per category and full owned drain. Cache pixel ceiling 8 MiB applies to this synthetic image workload, not to all shop data. Input desktop validity remains independently mandatory; control is not qualification.
